chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Mu'awiyah ibn Hakim, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Aban ibn 'Uthman, from 'Abd al-Rahman, who said:

I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a woman who menstruated, then became pure while traveling, but did not find water for two or three days: may her husband have intercourse with her? He said: "It is not permissible for her husband to have intercourse with her until she performs ghusl (ritual bath)."

key_terms.يَقَعَ عَلَيْهَا: to have sexual intercourse with her

ai.seo_question: Can a husband have intercourse with his wife after her menstruation ends if she has not yet performed ghusl due to lack of water?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a menstruating woman who becomes pure during travel but cannot find water. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that her husband may not have intercourse with her until she performs ghusl, making ritual purification a condition in this case.
